newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends barely changed in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends barely changed in light trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed barely changed against the U.S. dollar on Friday in light trade amid a lack of market-moving factors, brokers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.495 against Thursday's T$27.496 close.
Turnover through dealers was a light US$171 million.
Dealers expected a stable trend to continue.
"There wasn't a strong demand for either currency today. It was a pretty boring market," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.49-50 range was seen for Saturday's shortened session. -- Kevin Chen (5080815)
